title: How AI companions could deepen social inequality
title_zh: AI 伴侣如何加剧社会不平等
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) companions promise connection at low cost, but their effects are not evenly distributed. When user vulnerabilities, platform control loopholes, and governance gaps coincide, these systems risk deepening inequalities by exposing vulnerable users to more risks.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）伴侣以低成本承诺提供连接，但其影响并非均匀分布。当用户的脆弱性、平台的控制漏洞以及治理的空白同时出现时，这些系统有可能通过暴露弱势用户面临的更多风险来加剧不平等。
